description: US provider NPI verification (batch) — Verify up to 20 US healthcare provider NPI numbers in one call against the CMS NPPES registry: offline Luhn check-digit validation first (invalid numbers are never looked up), then ACTIVE / INACTIVE / NOT_FOUND status, name, credential, primary specialty and practice location per NPI, with a roster verdict, a needs-review list and specialty/state rollups. For credentialing and claims pre-checks. npis = comma-separated 10-digit NPIs. Price: $0.025 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: health_npi_batch
